items.title: Microbiome and metabolites impact enteric and central nervous systems in ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) has been linked to gastrointestinal symptoms and alterations in the gut microbiota. The enteric nervous system (ENS) coordinates intestinal function and sits at the host-microbe interface. The mechanisms by which luminal changes relay to the central nervous system (CNS), where motor neurons reside, have yet to be completely defined. In this narrative review, we first present evidence from ALS patient cohorts and preclinical models alongside mechanistic studies of infection, dysbiosis, and related neurodegenerative diseases to discuss how the microbiota and its metabolites may affect the ENS and CNS in ALS. Next, we propose a plausible mechanism of ALS pathogenesis through the gut-microbiome-brain axis. We further offer a summary of clinical trials that have studied the impacts of the microbiota on human ALS. Finally, we discuss future directions for studies of microbiota-ENS-CNS interactions in ALS. Better understanding of the dynamic interactions among the microbiota, microbial metabolites, neuroactive metabolites, and inflammation through the ENS/CNS in ALS will provide innovative insights into ALS prevention and treatment.
items.titleZh: 微生物组和代谢物影响ALS中的肠道和中枢神经系统
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了ALS患者和动物模型中肠道微生物群及其代谢物如何通过肠-微生物组-脑轴影响肠道神经系统和中枢神经系统，并回顾了相关临床试验，提出未来研究方向。
items.insight: 该综述系统整合了ALS中微生物组、代谢物与神经系统的相互作用，为通过调节肠道菌群干预ALS提供了理论基础和临床试验线索，值得关注其转化潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 微生物群及其代谢物通过肠-微生物组-脑轴影响ALS中的肠道和中枢神经系统，可能参与ALS发病机制。
aiRead.limitation: 作为叙述性综述，未进行系统性文献检索或定量分析，结论基于现有研究的整合。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS患者肠道微生物组的干预性临床试验，以及微生物代谢物（如短链脂肪酸）对神经保护作用的机制研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）与胃肠道症状和肠道微生物群改变有关。肠道神经系统（ENS）协调肠道功能，并位于宿主-微生物界面。管腔变化如何传递到运动神经元所在的中枢神经系统（CNS）的机制尚未完全明确。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们首先呈现来自ALS患者队列和临床前模型的证据，以及感染、菌群失调和相关神经退行性疾病的机制研究，以讨论微生物群及其代谢物如何影响ALS中的ENS和CNS。接着，我们通过肠-微生物组-脑轴提出了一种ALS发病机制的合理机制。我们进一步总结了研究微生物群对人类ALS影响的临床试验。最后，我们讨论了ALS中微生物群-ENS-CNS相互作用研究的未来方向。更好地理解ALS中微生物群、微生物代谢物、神经活性代谢物和炎症通过ENS/CNS的动态相互作用，将为ALS的预防和治疗提供创新见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，聚焦ALS中微生物组-ENS-CNS轴这一新兴前沿，整合了最新临床和机制证据，具有高ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性横断面研究分析了135名ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、红细胞沉降率（ESR）和咬肌厚度与男性患者存在显著差异，且这些差异在调整年龄、病程、BMI等变量后部分仍然存在。研究提示，在解读ALS患者的炎症和超声指标时，应考虑性别和体型因素。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统评估了ALS患者中常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并强调了在临床解读中纳入性别和人体测量背景的重要性，为未来ALS的精准预后评估和个体化治疗策略提供了新视角。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积显著低于男性，而ESR和咬肌厚度则更高，这些差异在调整临床变量后部分仍存在。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法将超声差异归因于ALS特异性生物学；单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，可能存在选择偏倚。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注包含健康对照、纵向功能结局和身体成分评估的多中心前瞻性研究，以验证这些性别差异的疾病特异性和预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，具有显著的临床异质性。全身性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在ALS中均有研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全明确。本研究旨在检查ALS患者中常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用临床和人体测量变量后是否仍然存在。在这项回顾性横断面研究中，纳入了135名ALS患者。分析了常规炎症标志物，包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR），以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行了性别间比较，并应用错误发现率校正以处理多重检验。进行了多变量线性回归分析，调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、预测FVC%、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍存在显著差异，而ALSFRS-R差异为边缘显著。在完全调整的模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析后关联性不稳定。一项探索性二次分析显示，在完全调整后，女性患者抬腿时股直肌横截面积较小。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未出现在早期调整模型中而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者之间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和基于超声的结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景，包括体型。由于缺乏健康对照组，观察到的超声差异不能明确归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照组、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究来阐明这些观察结果的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，聚焦ALS中炎症和神经肌肉超声指标的性别差异，具有新近性和ALS相关性，为理解疾病异质性和优化临床评估提供了转化价值。

items.title: Multiplex Panel Detects Glial and Inflammatory Biomarker Signatures in Sporadic and C9orf72-ALS.
items.summary: CSF proteomics has emerged as a valuable strategy for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the limited availability and volumes of CSF samples restrict the broader clinical application of CSF-based biomarker panels. To address this challenge, we investigated whether the novel nucleic acid-linked immuno-sandwich assay (NULISA) multiplex platform-capable of quantifying multiple neural, glial, and inflammatory markers from minimal biofluid volumes-could validate previously proposed biomarkers and identify additional candidates relevant to ALS. Using this platform, we measured a targeted panel of 131 biomarkers in cohorts of patients with C9orf72-associated ALS, sporadic ALS (sALS), and matched healthy controls. The 6 markers neurofilament heavy chain (NEFH) and neurofilament light chain (NEFL), chitinases-particularly chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1) and chitinase-3-like protein-1 (CHI3L1), and chemokines CCL2 and CCL3 were significantly elevated in both ALS groups compared with controls. These biomarkers correlated with disease progression and demonstrated strong diagnostic performance when combined into aggregate scores, as reflected by a high area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for ALS. Notably, C9orf72-ALS patients exhibited higher levels of the oxidative stress-related markers PRDX6 and ENO2, compared with sALS patients, suggesting a genotype-specific molecular signature. Overall, our findings support the use of a multiplexed panel of diverse, inflammatory, glial, and neurodegeneration-associated biomarkers as a complementary diagnostic and prognostic tool alongside established measurements of neurofilaments. This approach may enhance biomarker robustness while minimizing CSF volume requirements, thereby improving clinical feasibility in ALS research and care.
items.titleZh: 多重检测面板检测散发性和C9orf72-ALS中的胶质和炎症生物标志物特征
items.summaryZh: 本研究利用新型NULISA多重平台，在少量脑脊液中同时检测131种生物标志物，发现NEFL、NEFH、CHIT1、CHI3L1、CCL2和CCL3在ALS患者中显著升高，且C9orf72-ALS患者有独特的氧化应激标志物特征。
items.insight: 该研究展示了NULISA平台在ALS生物标志物发现中的潜力，通过减少样本需求实现多标志物联合分析，为临床诊断和分型提供了更高效的工具。

aiRead.keyFinding: NULISA平台可检测ALS患者脑脊液中6种显著升高的生物标志物，且C9orf72-ALS患者有独特的PRDX6和ENO2特征。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量有限，且未在独立队列中验证结果。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该平台在更大ALS队列中的验证，以及PRDX6和ENO2作为C9orf72-ALS特异性标志物的进一步研究。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白质组学已成为识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症诊断和预后生物标志物的有价值策略。然而，脑脊液样本的有限可用性和体积限制了基于脑脊液的生物标志物面板的更广泛临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了新型核酸连接免疫夹心检测多重平台——能够从最小生物流体体积中量化多种神经、胶质和炎症标志物——是否能验证先前提出的生物标志物并识别与ALS相关的其他候选标志物。使用该平台，我们在C9orf72相关ALS、散发性ALS和匹配健康对照队列中测量了131种生物标志物的靶向面板。与对照组相比，两种ALS组中6种标志物——神经丝重链和神经丝轻链、几丁质酶（特别是壳三糖苷酶-1和几丁质酶-3样蛋白-1）以及趋化因子CCL2和CCL3——显著升高。这些生物标志物与疾病进展相关，并在组合成综合评分时表现出强大的诊断性能，如ALS的受试者工作特征曲线下面积较高所示。值得注意的是，与sALS患者相比，C9orf72-ALS患者表现出更高水平的氧化应激相关标志物PRDX6和ENO2，提示基因型特异性分子特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持使用包含多种炎症、胶质和神经退行性相关生物标志物的多重面板，作为神经丝既定测量的补充诊断和预后工具。该方法可在最小化脑脊液体积需求的同时增强生物标志物的稳健性，从而提高ALS研究和护理的临床可行性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用2025年新近开发的NULISA多重平台，在ALS中首次验证了基因型特异性氧化应激标志物，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Are T1-weighted and T2-weighted volumetric pipelines interchangeable methodologies for investigating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathology in vivo?
items.summary: To test the hypothesis that T1-w and T2-w volumetric pipelines are not interchangeable, particularly regarding their differential sensitivity to physiological traits and disease effects in the red nucleus (RN) and substantia nigra (SN). Thirty-one patients with ALS (mean age: 59.39 ± 8.73 years; 23 males) and 21 non-neurodegenerative controls (mean age: 53.43 ± 10.01 years; 16 males). Bilateral RN and SN volumes were automatically extracted using deep learning pipelines optimized for T1-w (OpenMAP-T1) and T2-w (pBrain) images. Volumes were normalized to total intracranial volume. A 2 × 2 × 2 repeated-measures general linear model (GLM) assessed interactions between Method, Region, Side, and Group, controlling for age, sex, BMI, and handedness. There was no significant main effect of the disease group (p = 0.829) or Method × Group interaction (p = 0.682), indicating both pipelines agreed on the absence of disease-specific macrostructural atrophy. However, a significant four-way Method × Region × Side × Age interaction (P = 0.031) was observed. In the RN, the T2-w pipeline detected robust age-related atrophy (Left: Slope = -1.84 × 10 -6 ; Right: Slope = -1.70 ×10⁻⁶), whereas the T1-w pipeline did not (p > 0.05). Conversely, in the SN, T1-w consistently identified bilateral age-related loss, whereas T2-w yielded lateralized results (Right: p = 0.011; Left: P = 0.465). T1-w and T2-w pipelines are not interchangeable. Though both confirm the absence of gross atrophy in this ALS cohort, their differing sensitivity to physiological aging highlights their distinct biological tissue properties, requiring method-specific interpretation.
items.titleZh: T1加权与T2加权体积分析流程在肌萎缩侧索硬化症体内病理研究中的可互换性探讨
items.summaryZh: 本研究比较了T1加权和T2加权MRI体积分析流程在ALS患者红核和黑质中的应用，发现两种方法在检测疾病相关萎缩上结果一致（均未发现显著萎缩），但对年龄相关变化的敏感性不同：T2加权对红核更敏感，T1加权对黑质更敏感。这表明两种方法不可互换，需根据具体脑区和研究目的选择。
items.insight: 该研究提醒ALS研究者，在利用MRI体积分析评估脑干核团时，不同加权成像的流程可能对生理和病理变化有不同敏感性，需谨慎解释结果，避免因方法选择导致假阴性或偏倚。

aiRead.keyFinding: T1加权和T2加权体积分析流程在ALS患者中均未检测到红核和黑质的宏观萎缩，但对年龄相关变化的敏感性不同，表明两者不可互换。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（31例ALS患者），且未评估其他脑区或纵向变化。
aiRead.watchNext: 未来研究应探索多模态MRI（如扩散张量成像）与体积分析结合，以更全面评估ALS中的脑干病理变化。

items.abstractZh: 为检验T1加权（T1-w）和T2加权（T2-w）体积分析流程不可互换的假设，特别是两者对红核（RN）和黑质（SN）生理特征及疾病效应的敏感性差异。研究对象包括31例ALS患者（平均年龄：59.39±8.73岁；23名男性）和21名非神经退行性对照（平均年龄：53.43±10.01岁；16名男性）。使用针对T1-w（OpenMAP-T1）和T2-w（pBrain）图像优化的深度学习流程自动提取双侧RN和SN体积，并标准化为总颅内体积。采用2×2×2重复测量一般线性模型（GLM）评估方法、区域、侧别和组别之间的交互作用，并控制年龄、性别、BMI和利手。未发现疾病组的主效应显著（p=0.829）或方法×组别交互作用显著（p=0.682），表明两种流程均一致显示无疾病特异性宏观结构萎缩。然而，观察到显著的四向方法×区域×侧别×年龄交互作用（p=0.031）。在RN中，T2-w流程检测到稳健的年龄相关萎缩（左侧：斜率=-1.84×10⁻⁶；右侧：斜率=-1.70×10⁻⁶），而T1-w流程未检测到（p>0.05）。相反，在SN中，T1-w一致识别出双侧年龄相关损失，而T2-w产生侧化结果（右侧：p=0.011；左侧：p=0.465）。T1-w和T2-w流程不可互换。尽管两者均确认该ALS队列中无大体萎缩，但它们对生理性衰老的不同敏感性凸显了其不同的生物组织特性，需要方法特异性解释。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，直接针对ALS中脑干核团（红核和黑质）的MRI体积分析方法学差异，具有ALS相关性和方法学转化价值。

items.title: Deletion of exon 2 in ALS-linked Sptlc1 causes lethality in homozygous mice but not in heterozygotes.
items.summary: Mutations in the human SPTLC1 gene have recently been linked to early-onset amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), characterized by global atrophy, motor impairments, and symptoms such as tongue fasciculations. All known ALS-linked SPTLC1 mutations cluster within exon 2, and a specific variant, c.58G>T, results in exon 2 skipping. However, it is unclear how the exon 2 deletion affects SPTLC1 function in vivo and contributes to ALS pathogenesis. Leveraging the high genomic sequence similarity between mouse and human SPTLC1 , we created a novel knock-in mouse model with a CRISPR/Cas9-mediated deletion of exon 2 in the endogenous murine Sptlc1 locus. Although heterozygous mice did not develop motor defects or ALS-like neuropathology, homozygous mutants died prematurely. These findings provide valuable insights into SPTLC1 exon 2 biology and serve as a useful resource for future mechanistic studies.
items.titleZh: ALS相关Sptlc1基因外显子2缺失导致纯合子小鼠致死，但杂合子小鼠存活
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过构建Sptlc1外显子2缺失的敲入小鼠模型，发现纯合子小鼠致死，而杂合子小鼠未出现运动缺陷或ALS样病理，提示外显子2缺失可能不足以单独引发ALS表型，但为理解SPTLC1突变在ALS中的作用提供了基础。
items.insight: 该研究首次在体内验证了ALS相关SPTLC1外显子2缺失的效应，明确了纯合子致死性，但杂合子无表型，提示该突变可能需与其他因素协同致病，为ALS遗传机制研究提供了关键动物模型。

aiRead.keyFinding: Sptlc1外显子2缺失导致纯合子小鼠致死，但杂合子小鼠无运动缺陷或ALS样神经病理改变。
aiRead.limitation: 杂合子小鼠未表现出ALS表型，可能无法完全模拟人类疾病；研究未探讨其他潜在致病机制或环境因素。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该模型是否可用于研究SPTLC1突变与其他ALS相关基因或环境因素的相互作用，以及外显子2缺失对鞘脂代谢的具体影响。

items.abstractZh: 人类SPTLC1基因的突变最近被关联到早发性肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS），其特征为全身性萎缩、运动障碍以及舌肌束颤等症状。所有已知的ALS相关SPTLC1突变均聚集在外显子2内，其中特定变异c.58G>T导致外显子2跳跃。然而，外显子2缺失如何影响SPTLC1在体内的功能并促进ALS发病机制尚不清楚。利用小鼠和人类SPTLC1之间高度相似的基因组序列，我们通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的内源性小鼠Sptlc1基因座外显子2缺失，创建了一种新型敲入小鼠模型。尽管杂合子小鼠未出现运动缺陷或ALS样神经病理学改变，但纯合子突变体过早死亡。这些发现为SPTLC1外显子2的生物学功能提供了有价值的见解，并为未来的机制研究提供了有用资源。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9技术构建了ALS相关Sptlc1外显子2缺失的小鼠模型，是近期（2026年）针对SPTLC1突变在ALS中体内功能的首个直接验证，具有高度ALS相关性。

items.title: Association of Plasma Neurofilament Light Chain With Diagnostic Classification in a Neuromuscular Referral Cohort: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: Plasma neurofilament light chain (pNfL) is a blood-based biomarker of axonal injury elevated in several neuromuscular disorders. While previous studies have compared individual diseases with healthy controls, less is known about how pNfL performs across clinically relevant neuromuscular presentations encountered in subspecialty practice, particularly in distinguishing active from inactive neuropathies. We evaluated whether abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations are associated with clinically relevant diagnostic categories and whether pNfL discriminates between active and inactive neuropathies. We conducted a cross-sectional study of patients evaluated by neuromuscular specialists at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) between April 2022 and April 2024, in whom pNfL was ordered as part of routine clinical care. Diagnoses were assigned to prespecified categories by consensus review, including motor neuron disease (MND), active neuropathy, inactive neuropathy, and structural etiologies. Clinically active neuropathy was defined using prespecified, diagnosis-specific operational criteria incorporating treatment status, clinical relapse or progression, time from symptom onset, and pathologic evidence of inflammation. Abnormal pNfL was defined using previously established age-adjusted 97.5th percentile reference limits. Multinomial logistic regression evaluated associations between abnormal pNfL and diagnostic category, adjusting for neuropathy impairment score and symptom duration. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses assessed discrimination between prespecified groups. Among 306 patients (mean age 62.2 years, 41.5% female), 179 (58.5%) had MND, 28 (9.1%) active neuropathy, 75 (12.1%) inactive neuropathy, and 24 (7.8%) structural etiologies. Median pNfL concentrations differed across diagnostic groups ( p < 0.0001) and were highest in MND and active neuropathy. After adjustment, abnormal pNfL was associated with a higher relative likelihood of classification as MND (relative risk ratio [RRR] 18.47, 95% CI 8.77-38.86) and active neuropathy (RRR 7.30, 95% CI 2.50-21.34) compared with inactive neuropathies. No association was observed with structural etiologies. Discrimination between active and inactive neuropathy was moderate (area under the curve [AUC] 0.79, 95% CI 0.70-0.88), and discrimination for MND vs all other diagnoses was good (AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.90). In this cross-sectional cohort, abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations were more frequently observed in diagnostic categories characterized by clinically active axonal injury than in inactive neuropathies and structural conditions. These findings suggest a potential role for pNfL as an adjunctive tool in neuromuscular diagnostic evaluation. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and convenience sampling. This study provides Class II evidence that abnormal age-adjusted pNfL distinguishes active neuropathies from inactive neuropathies with moderate diagnostic accuracy.
items.titleZh: 血浆神经丝轻链与神经肌肉转诊队列中诊断分类的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究在神经肌肉专科转诊队列中评估了血浆NfL（pNfL）的诊断价值。研究发现，年龄校正后异常的pNfL浓度在运动神经元病（包括ALS）和活动性神经病变患者中显著升高，能较好地区分活动性与非活动性神经病变（AUC 0.79），并能良好区分MND与其他诊断（AUC 0.85）。pNfL可能作为神经肌肉疾病诊断评估的辅助生物标志物。
items.insight: 该研究直接验证了pNfL在真实世界神经肌肉专科门诊中的鉴别诊断效能，特别是区分活动性轴突损伤（如ALS）与非活动性病变，为pNfL作为ALS等疾病活动性监测和诊断辅助工具提供了临床证据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 年龄校正后异常pNfL浓度在MND（包括ALS）和活动性神经病变中显著升高，能中等至良好地区分活动性与非活动性神经病变（AUC 0.79）以及MND与其他诊断（AUC 0.85）。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果关系；便利抽样可能引入选择偏倚；样本量相对有限，且来自单一中心。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注前瞻性纵向研究，验证pNfL在ALS病程监测和预后预测中的动态变化，以及与其他生物标志物（如p-tau、GFAP）的联合诊断价值。

items.abstractZh: 血浆神经丝轻链（pNfL）是一种基于血液的轴突损伤生物标志物，在多种神经肌肉疾病中升高。虽然既往研究已将个别疾病与健康对照进行比较，但关于pNfL在亚专科实践中遇到的临床相关神经肌肉表现中的表现，尤其是在区分活动性与非活动性神经病变方面的表现，所知甚少。我们评估了异常的年龄校正pNfL浓度是否与临床相关的诊断类别相关，以及pNfL是否能区分活动性和非活动性神经病变。我们对2022年4月至2024年4月期间在梅奥诊所（罗切斯特，明尼苏达州）由神经肌肉专家评估的患者进行了一项横断面研究，这些患者的pNfL检测作为常规临床护理的一部分。通过共识审查将诊断分配到预设类别，包括运动神经元病（MND）、活动性神经病变、非活动性神经病变和结构性病因。临床活动性神经病变的定义采用预设的、诊断特异性的操作标准，包括治疗状态、临床复发或进展、症状发作时间以及炎症的病理学证据。异常pNfL的定义采用先前建立的年龄校正的第97.5百分位参考限值。多项逻辑回归评估了异常pNfL与诊断类别之间的关联，并调整了神经病变损伤评分和症状持续时间。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估了预设组之间的区分能力。在306名患者（平均年龄62.2岁，41.5%为女性）中，179名（58.5%）患有MND，28名（9.1%）患有活动性神经病变，75名（12.1%）患有非活动性神经病变，24名（7.8%）患有结构性病因。不同诊断组的中位pNfL浓度存在差异（p < 0.0001），且在MND和活动性神经病变中最高。调整后，与非活动性神经病变相比，异常pNfL与分类为MND（相对风险比[RRR] 18.47，95% CI 8.77-38.86）和活动性神经病变（RRR 7.30，95% CI 2.50-21.34）的相对可能性较高相关。未观察到与结构性病因的关联。活动性与非活动性神经病变之间的区分能力中等（曲线下面积[AUC] 0.79，95% CI 0.70-0.88），而MND与所有其他诊断的区分能力良好（AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.90）。在这个横断面队列中，异常的年龄校正pNfL浓度在临床活动性轴突损伤特征的诊断类别中比在非活动性神经病变和结构性病变中更常见。这些发现提示pNfL作为神经肌肉诊断评估中辅助工具的潜在作用。横断面设计和便利抽样限制了结果的解读。本研究提供了II类证据，表明异常年龄校正pNfL能以中等诊断准确性区分活动性神经病变与非活动性神经病变。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，基于近期临床队列数据，直接评估了pNfL在ALS相关运动神经元病鉴别诊断中的实际表现，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Neurology ® Journal Club: Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk.
items.summary: This article critically appraises the study by Nakken et al., "Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) Risk." Previous observational studies and Mendelian randomization studies examining statin use and ALS risk have reported mixed results. Millions of adults receive statins for cardiovascular prevention and may be concerned when neuromuscular symptoms suggestive of ALS appear. Using linked nationwide health survey and prescription data, this Norwegian population-based cohort study applied time-dependent models to evaluate statin use and subsequent ALS risk. Short-term statin use was associated with increased ALS risk, whereas long-term use was associated with lower risk. The authors interpreted this as evidence of reverse causation rather than a causal or protective effect of statins. Key strengths of the study include its large population-based design, the use of a negative control, and time-dependent Cox modeling. However, limitations inherent to observational study designs and potential residual confounding should be considered. In this article, we summarize the findings, highlight key statistical concepts, and discuss the study's major strengths and limitations.
items.titleZh: 神经病学杂志俱乐部：当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化风险
items.summaryZh: 挪威一项基于人群的队列研究显示，短期他汀使用与ALS风险升高相关，而长期使用则与风险降低相关。作者认为这更可能是反向因果关系（即早期ALS症状导致他汀使用增加），而非他汀的保护作用。研究利用全国健康调查和处方数据，采用时间依赖模型，并设置了阴性对照，但观察性设计的残余混杂仍需注意。
items.insight: 该研究通过时间依赖模型和阴性对照设计，为“他汀使用与ALS风险”这一长期争议提供了新的流行病学证据，提示观察到的关联可能源于反向因果，对临床医生解读他汀与ALS症状的关系具有重要参考价值。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性队列研究（Journal Club评论）
aiRead.keyFinding: 短期他汀使用与ALS风险增加相关，长期使用与风险降低相关，但更支持反向因果解释。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性设计无法完全排除残余混杂；Journal Club文章本身为二次评论，未提供原始数据细节。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续孟德尔随机化研究或更精细的处方时间窗分析，以进一步区分因果与反向因果。

items.abstractZh: 本文对Nakken等人的研究“当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险”进行了批判性评价。先前关于他汀类药物使用与ALS风险的观察性研究和孟德尔随机化研究报告了不一致的结果。数百万成年人因心血管预防接受他汀类药物治疗，当出现提示ALS的神经肌肉症状时可能感到担忧。利用全国性健康调查和处方数据，这项挪威基于人群的队列研究采用时间依赖模型评估了他汀类药物使用与后续ALS风险。短期他汀类药物使用与ALS风险增加相关，而长期使用与较低风险相关。作者将其解释为反向因果关系的证据，而非他汀类药物的因果或保护作用。该研究的主要优势包括其大型人群基础设计、阴性对照的使用以及时间依赖Cox模型。然而，应考虑观察性研究设计固有的局限性和潜在的残余混杂因素。本文总结了研究结果，强调了关键统计概念，并讨论了研究的主要优势和局限性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新发表的挪威全国队列数据，采用时间依赖模型和阴性对照，直接回应了他汀使用与ALS风险关联的长期争议，具有较高的ALS转化流行病学价值。

items.title: Interventional Procedures for Musculoskeletal Pain in ALS Patients: A Case Series.
items.summary: Many patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) experience musculoskeletal pain, yet data on the safety and efficacy of interventional procedures for pain relief in this population are limited. This study aims to describe the characteristics, outcomes, and procedural considerations of pain interventions performed for musculoskeletal pain in ALS patients. A retrospective chart review was conducted of ALS patients referred for interventional pain management by a neuromuscular physiatrist at a single academic institution's interdisciplinary ALS Center between February 2021 and February 2025. Eleven patients (mean age: 57 y, 64% male) underwent 14 procedures. Shoulder pain was the most common indication (43%), followed by spine (29%) and hip (14%) pain. Procedures mostly consisted of joint and bursal injections peripherally and of epidural injections in the axial spine. Overall, 13 of 14 (93%) procedures provided at least "good" pain relief, and 5 patients elected to repeat their procedures. One patient experienced transient postprocedure hypertension; no major complications occurred. Interventional procedures, particularly corticosteroid injections, appear to be safe and effective for managing focal musculoskeletal pain in patients with ALS. Tailored procedural techniques and multidisciplinary coordination can enhance comfort and optimize outcomes in this complex population.
items.titleZh: ALS患者肌肉骨骼疼痛的介入治疗：病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性病例系列研究显示，针对ALS患者的肌肉骨骼疼痛（尤其是肩部疼痛），介入性手术（如皮质类固醇注射）在93%的病例中提供了至少良好的疼痛缓解，且未出现重大并发症。研究基于11名患者14次手术的数据，表明这些干预措施在ALS患者中是安全有效的。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS患者疼痛管理领域的数据空白，提供了介入性手术（如关节注射和硬膜外注射）在ALS患者中安全性和有效性的初步证据，有助于指导临床实践，改善患者生活质量。

aiRead.keyFinding: 介入性手术（主要是皮质类固醇注射）在93%的ALS患者中提供了至少良好的疼痛缓解，且安全性良好。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量小（11名患者），回顾性设计，缺乏对照组，可能无法推广至所有ALS患者。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要更大规模的前瞻性研究或随机对照试验来验证这些发现，并探索不同介入技术的长期效果。

items.abstractZh: 许多肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者经历肌肉骨骼疼痛，但关于介入性疼痛缓解手术在该人群中安全性和有效性的数据有限。本研究旨在描述ALS患者因肌肉骨骼疼痛接受疼痛介入治疗的特征、结果和手术注意事项。对2021年2月至2025年2月期间，由一家学术机构跨学科ALS中心的神经肌肉康复医师转诊接受介入性疼痛管理的ALS患者进行了回顾性病历审查。11名患者（平均年龄：57岁，64%为男性）接受了14次手术。肩部疼痛是最常见的适应症（43%），其次是脊柱（29%）和髋部（14%）疼痛。手术主要包括外周关节和滑囊注射以及轴性脊柱的硬膜外注射。总体而言，14次手术中有13次（93%）提供了至少“良好”的疼痛缓解，5名患者选择重复手术。一名患者出现短暂术后高血压；未发生重大并发症。介入性手术，特别是皮质类固醇注射，对于管理ALS患者的局灶性肌肉骨骼疼痛似乎是安全有效的。量身定制的手术技术和多学科协调可以增强该复杂人群的舒适度并优化结果。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2021-2025年的近期数据，直接针对ALS患者疼痛管理的临床需求，具有ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Mutant superoxide dismutase 1-catalyzed hydrogen therapy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis achieved by intercepting oxidative stress-neuroinflammation crosstalk.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the brain and spinal cord, with mutant superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) induced oxidative stress and neuroinflammation as key pathogenic drivers. Here, we uncover that mutant SOD1 is both a Fenton-like agent able for catalytical generation of ·OH and a hydrogenation catalyst for H 2 scavenging reactive oxygen species. To enhance the bioavailability of H 2 , we develop an orally administered Mg 2 Si nanosheets based feed for sustained release of high-amount H 2 . On an ALS model of hSOD1 G93A transgenic mice, Mg 2 Si feed remarkably delays ALS progression, improves the motor performance of ALS mice, and extends their lifespan. Histopathologically, oral Mg 2 Si treatment ameliorates motor neuron degeneration, misfolded SOD1 aggregation and reactive gliosis in spinal cord, while protecting neuromuscular junctions and ameliorating muscle atrophy during disease progression. Transcriptomic analysis demonstrates the H 2 -mediated down-regulation of both oxidative stress and neuroinflammatory pathways in response to the suppression of NLRP3 inflammasome activation. The proposed strategy of catalyzed hydrogen therapy offers an inspiration for metalloproteases-related neurodegenerative diseases treatment. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is an incurable and devastating neurodegenerative disease lacking effective clinical interventions. Although hydrogen gas (H 2 ) exhibits promising neuroprotective potential, conventional H 2 therapy is severely limited by unstable and transient H 2 release, failing to sustain long-term treatment requirements for chronic ALS pathogenesis. To overcome this bottleneck, we engineer oral administrable Mg 2 Si nanosheets that enable sustained H 2 release via gastrointestinal retention, achieving stable long-term hydrogen supplementation in vivo. Mechanistically, Mg 2 Si-derived H 2 efficiently eliminates excess free radicals triggered by toxic mutant SOD1, and further disrupts the pathological crosstalk between oxidative stress and neuroinflammation in ALS. In transgenic ALS mice, dietary Mg 2 Si intervention markedly ameliorates motor dysfunction and effectively delays disease progression. Collectively, this study firstly applies Mg 2 Si nanomaterial-based sustained hydrogen therapy for ALS treatment, establishes a novel gastrointestinal hydrogen delivery strategy, and provides an innovative and clinically translatable paradigm for the design of hydrogen delivery systems against neurodegenerative disorders.
items.titleZh: 突变超氧化物歧化酶1催化的氢疗法通过阻断氧化应激-神经炎症串扰治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症
items.summaryZh: 本研究开发了一种口服Mg₂Si纳米片，可在胃肠道持续释放氢气，用于治疗SOD1突变型ALS。在SOD1 G93A转基因小鼠模型中，该疗法显著延缓疾病进展、改善运动功能并延长生存期。机制上，氢气通过清除突变SOD1产生的自由基，抑制NLRP3炎症小体激活，从而阻断氧化应激与神经炎症的恶性循环。
items.insight: 该研究首次将基于Mg₂Si纳米材料的持续氢释放策略应用于ALS治疗，解决了传统氢气疗法释放不稳定、无法长期维持的瓶颈，为SOD1相关ALS提供了一种新颖、可口服且具有临床转化潜力的治疗思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 口服Mg₂Si纳米片持续释放氢气可显著延缓ALS小鼠疾病进展、改善运动功能并延长生存期，机制涉及清除自由基和抑制NLRP3炎症小体激活。
aiRead.limitation: 该研究仅在SOD1 G93A小鼠模型中进行，未在散发性ALS或其他基因突变模型中验证；且长期口服纳米材料的安全性需进一步评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该氢释放策略是否进入临床前安全性评估，以及是否在更广泛的ALS模型（如C9orf72、TDP-43）中验证效果。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是大脑和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性变性，突变超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）诱导的氧化应激和神经炎症是关键致病驱动因素。在此，我们发现突变SOD1既是一种类芬顿试剂，能够催化产生·OH，也是一种氢化催化剂，用于H₂清除活性氧。为了提高H₂的生物利用度，我们开发了一种基于口服Mg₂Si纳米片的饲料，用于持续释放高剂量H₂。在hSOD1 G93A转基因小鼠的ALS模型中，Mg₂Si饲料显著延缓了ALS进展，改善了ALS小鼠的运动表现，并延长了其寿命。在组织病理学上，口服Mg₂Si治疗改善了脊髓中的运动神经元变性、错误折叠SOD1聚集和反应性胶质增生，同时保护了神经肌肉接头并改善了疾病进展过程中的肌肉萎缩。转录组学分析表明，H₂介导的氧化应激和神经炎症通路下调是对NLRP3炎症小体激活抑制的响应。所提出的催化氢疗法策略为金属蛋白酶相关的神经退行性疾病治疗提供了启示。意义声明：肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种无法治愈的破坏性神经退行性疾病，缺乏有效的临床干预。尽管氢气（H₂）显示出有前景的神经保护潜力，但传统的H₂疗法受到不稳定和瞬时H₂释放的严重限制，无法满足慢性ALS发病机制的长期治疗需求。为克服这一瓶颈，我们设计了可口服的Mg₂Si纳米片，通过胃肠道滞留实现持续H₂释放，在体内实现稳定的长期氢补充。机制上，Mg₂Si衍生的H₂有效清除由毒性突变SOD1引发的过量自由基，并进一步破坏ALS中氧化应激和神经炎症之间的病理串扰。在转基因ALS小鼠中，饮食Mg₂Si干预显著改善了运动功能障碍，并有效延缓了疾病进展。总之，本研究首次将基于Mg₂Si纳米材料的持续氢疗法应用于ALS治疗，建立了一种新颖的胃肠道氢递送策略，并为针对神经退行性疾病的氢递送系统设计提供了创新且临床可转化的范式。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次利用Mg₂Si纳米材料实现胃肠道持续氢释放，针对SOD1突变型ALS的氧化应激-神经炎症串扰机制，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: The impedance mismatch theory: A non-equilibrium thermodynamic framework for a shared energetic stress pathway in neurodegeneration.
items.summary: Current neurobiological models of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and Huntington's Disease (HD) utilize multi-omic interactome analyses to map cascades of proteinopathy. While essential, these approaches often overlook the macroscopic thermodynamic limits of the neural substrate as an information processing system. We propose the Impedance Mismatch Theory, a theoretical biophysical model and quantitative framework for the thermodynamic limits of neural computation, positing that these distinct pathologies converge as a shared energetic stress pathway. We introduce the Neurophysiological Load Index (NLI)-a dimensionless parameter quantifying the mismatch between electrical computational drive, topological network impedance, and the local structural and microvascular dissipation capacity. Drawing on the Pennes Bioheat Transfer Equation and insights from multiplex network theory, we hypothesize that pathology initiates as localized thermal runaway, where resistive metabolic heat exceeds convective blood perfusion and thermal conduction, inducing acute decompensation. We outline cross-translational disease-network mechanisms, address the inverse cancer comorbidity paradox via speculative bioelectric attractor states, and propose falsifiable predictions involving high-resolution in vivo proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy thermometry ( 1 H-MRS-t) and phosphorus-31 magnetic resonance spectroscopy ( 31 P-MRS).
items.titleZh: 阻抗失配理论：神经退行性疾病中共享能量应激通路的非平衡热力学框架
items.summaryZh: 该理论提出，ALS、MS和HD等神经退行性疾病可能共享一个由能量代谢失衡驱动的共同病理通路，而非仅由蛋白质异常聚集引起。作者引入“神经生理负荷指数”来量化神经计算活动与散热能力之间的失配，并认为局部热失控是疾病启动的关键事件。
items.insight: 该理论为ALS研究者提供了一个全新的视角，将疾病机制从分子层面的蛋白质病变扩展到宏观的热力学和能量代谢层面，可能解释为何不同神经退行性疾病存在共同的代谢脆弱性，并提出了基于磁共振波谱测温的可检验预测。

aiRead.keyFinding: 提出阻抗失配理论，认为神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）的病理学源于神经计算活动与散热能力之间的热力学失配，而非仅由蛋白质病变级联引起。
aiRead.limitation: 该理论目前为纯理论模型，缺乏直接的实验验证；提出的可证伪预测（如基于MRS测温）尚未在ALS患者中实施。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否出现利用1H-MRS-t或31P-MRS在ALS患者中验证局部热失控假说的临床研究。

items.abstractZh: 当前关于肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、多发性硬化症（MS）和亨廷顿病（HD）的神经生物学模型利用多组学相互作用组分析来绘制蛋白质病变的级联反应。虽然这些方法至关重要，但它们常常忽略了作为信息处理系统的神经基质的宏观热力学极限。我们提出了阻抗失配理论，这是一个关于神经计算热力学极限的理论生物物理模型和定量框架，认为这些不同的病理学汇聚为一条共享的能量应激通路。我们引入了神经生理负荷指数（NLI）——一个无量纲参数，用于量化电计算驱动力、拓扑网络阻抗以及局部结构和微血管散热能力之间的失配。借鉴彭内斯生物传热方程和多层网络理论的见解，我们假设病理学起始于局部热失控，其中电阻性代谢热超过对流血液灌注和热传导，诱发急性失代偿。我们概述了跨转化疾病网络机制，通过推测性的生物电吸引子状态解决了癌症共病逆悖论，并提出了涉及高分辨率体内质子磁共振波谱测温（1H-MRS-t）和磷-31磁共振波谱（31P-MRS）的可证伪预测。
items.frontierRationale: 该理论发表于2026年，首次将非平衡热力学框架系统性地应用于ALS等神经退行性疾病的共享能量应激通路，具有高度的理论前沿性和转化潜力。

items.title: Role of the Upper Motor Neuron in the Generation of Fasciculations in Early Disease Stages of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: The origin of fasciculation potentials (FPs) in the early stages of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) remains a subject of debate. We investigated the role of the motor cortex in FP generation by comparing resting FP frequency in the first dorsal interosseous (FDI) muscle before and after motor cortex inhibition induced by continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS). We studied patients with early-stage ALS (G1) and a disease-control group (G2) comprising individuals with chronic lower motor neuron (LMN) disorders or benign fasciculation syndrome without upper motor neuron (UMN) involvement. Inclusion required a right FDI strength of MRC grade 4+ or 5. At baseline, we recorded FP frequency and amplitude in the right FDI (3 replicates) and the motor evoked potential (MEP) amplitude. These measures were repeated immediately after cTBS-induced corticomotor inhibition. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Twenty-two patients with ALS (14 men; median age 65.5 years; 72.7% spinal onset) were included, with a median disease duration of 6.4 months and a mean ALSFRS-R score of 44. The control group (G2) consisted of 11 participants. Notably, 50% of the ALS cohort showed no neurogenic features on needle EMG of the right FDI at enrollment. Baseline peripheral and cortical amplitudes and left hemisphere motor thresholds were comparable between groups. After cTBS, MEP amplitudes decreased significantly in both G1 (0.93 vs 0.50 mV, p = 0.02) and G2 (1.23 vs 0.38 mV, p = 0.02). However, a significant reduction in FP frequency (39.5%) occurred only in the ALS group (0.43 vs 0.26 Hz, p < 0.001), whereas no change was observed in G2 (0.60 vs 0.77 Hz, p = 0.14). Patients with ALS with a normal FDI EMG demonstrated an even greater reduction in FP frequency (54.5%). FP amplitudes remained stable across both groups after cTBS. Our findings indicate that in early ALS, LMN excitability is significantly modulated by descending corticospinal input. The reduction in FP frequency after cortical inhibition suggests that FPs in early ALS are driven by a combination of both UMN and LMN hyperexcitability, distinguishing them from fasciculations in other neurogenic disorders.
items.titleZh: 上运动神经元在肌萎缩侧索硬化早期阶段肌束震颤产生中的作用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过经颅磁刺激抑制运动皮层，发现早期ALS患者的肌束震颤频率显著下降，而其他神经源性疾病患者无此变化。这表明早期ALS的肌束震颤不仅源于下运动神经元，还受到上运动神经元过度兴奋的驱动。
items.insight: 该研究直接证明了上运动神经元在ALS早期肌束震颤产生中的关键作用，挑战了传统认为肌束震颤仅源于下运动神经元的观点，为理解ALS病理生理机制和开发针对皮层过度兴奋的治疗策略提供了新依据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 早期ALS患者运动皮层抑制后肌束震颤频率显著降低（39.5%），而其他神经源性疾病患者无变化，提示上运动神经元过度兴奋是早期ALS肌束震颤的重要来源。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（ALS组22例，对照组11例），且仅评估了单一肌肉（第一背侧骨间肌），可能限制结果的普适性。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可探索针对皮层过度兴奋的治疗（如经颅磁刺激或药物）是否能减少肌束震颤并延缓疾病进展。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期阶段肌束震颤电位（FPs）的起源仍存在争议。我们通过比较连续θ爆发刺激（cTBS）抑制运动皮层前后第一背侧骨间肌（FDI）的静息FP频率，研究了运动皮层在FP产生中的作用。研究对象包括早期ALS患者（G1）和疾病对照组（G2），后者由慢性下运动神经元（LMN）疾病或无上运动神经元（UMN）受累的良性肌束震颤综合征患者组成。纳入标准要求右侧FDI肌力为MRC 4+或5级。基线时，我们记录了右侧FDI的FP频率和振幅（3次重复）以及运动诱发电位（MEP）振幅。在cTBS诱导的皮质运动抑制后立即重复这些测量。统计学显著性设为p < 0.05。共纳入22例ALS患者（14名男性；中位年龄65.5岁；72.7%为脊髓起病），中位病程6.4个月，平均ALSFRS-R评分为44。对照组（G2）由11名参与者组成。值得注意的是，50%的ALS队列在入组时右侧FDI的针极肌电图未显示神经源性特征。两组间基线外周和皮质振幅以及左半球运动阈值具有可比性。cTBS后，G1组（0.93 vs 0.50 mV，p = 0.02）和G2组（1.23 vs 0.38 mV，p = 0.02）的MEP振幅均显著下降。然而，仅在ALS组中观察到FP频率显著降低（39.5%）（0.43 vs 0.26 Hz，p < 0.001），而G2组无变化（0.60 vs 0.77 Hz，p = 0.14）。FDI肌电图正常的ALS患者FP频率降低更显著（54.5%）。cTBS后两组FP振幅保持稳定。我们的研究结果表明，在早期ALS中，LMN兴奋性受到下行皮质脊髓输入的显著调节。皮质抑制后FP频率的降低提示，早期ALS中的FPs是由UMN和LMN过度兴奋共同驱动的，这使其与其他神经源性疾病中的肌束震颤有所区别。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次通过皮层抑制实验在早期ALS患者中证实上运动神经元对肌束震颤的驱动作用，具有直接的ALS机制相关性。

items.title: The aging brain that doesn't fail: how neural resilience masks neurodegeneration.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Alzheimer's disease, and Parkinson's disease are usually framed as consequences of aging-related pathogenic processes, including impaired proteostasis with protein aggregation, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation. Yet, most individuals, even into advanced age, do not develop clinically significant neurodegenerative disease. This discrepancy suggests that the nervous system possesses robust and redundant protective mechanisms that maintain neural integrity despite cumulative molecular and cellular stress. In this perspective, we propose that neurodegenerative diseases arise not simply from the presence of pathogenic processes, but when integrated resilience systems fail to maintain homeostasis or when reserve mechanisms no longer compensate for accumulated pathology. We have synthesized a threshold-based model of disease emergence based on evidence across proteostasis, mitochondrial function, neuroimmune regulation, glial biology, network-level compensation, and barrier integrity, while integrating genetic, environmental, developmental, and stochastic modifiers. We distinguish biological resilience, which actively limits or repairs pathology, from reserve, which permits function despite pathology. We further propose that clinical disease emerges only when age-related cumulative stress exceeds the combined capacity of resilience and reserve. Reframing neurodegeneration as a failure of preservation systems offers new directions for prevention and therapeutic development.
items.titleZh: 不衰老的大脑：神经韧性如何掩盖神经退行性变
items.summaryZh: 本文提出神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）并非单纯由致病过程引起，而是当大脑的“韧性”和“储备”系统无法应对累积损伤时才出现临床疾病。作者构建了一个阈值模型，区分了主动修复病理的“生物学韧性”和允许功能代偿的“储备”，并认为临床发病是年龄相关应激超过两者总容量的结果。
items.insight: 该观点为ALS研究提供了新的理论框架：治疗不应仅针对致病机制（如蛋白聚集、线粒体功能障碍），还应增强大脑自身的韧性系统（如蛋白稳态、神经免疫调节、胶质细胞功能）和储备能力（如网络代偿），这可能开辟预防和延缓ALS发病的新策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 神经退行性疾病的发生是年龄相关累积应激超过大脑韧性和储备联合能力的结果，而非仅由致病过程驱动。
aiRead.limitation: 该文为观点性文章，提出的阈值模型基于现有证据的综合，缺乏直接的实验验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否能在ALS动物模型中验证韧性系统的增强能否延缓或阻止疾病发生，以及开发针对韧性通路（如蛋白稳态、神经免疫调节）的干预措施。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化、阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病通常被视为衰老相关致病过程的结果，包括蛋白稳态受损伴蛋白聚集、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激和神经炎症。然而，大多数个体，即使到高龄，也不会发展出临床显著的神经退行性疾病。这种差异表明，神经系统拥有强大且冗余的保护机制，能够在累积的分子和细胞应激下维持神经完整性。在这篇观点文章中，我们提出神经退行性疾病的发生不仅仅源于致病过程的存在，而是当整合的韧性系统无法维持稳态，或储备机制不再能补偿累积的病理时才会出现。我们基于蛋白稳态、线粒体功能、神经免疫调节、胶质细胞生物学、网络水平补偿和屏障完整性等方面的证据，综合了一个基于阈值的疾病发生模型，同时整合了遗传、环境、发育和随机修饰因素。我们将主动限制或修复病理的生物学韧性与允许在病理状态下维持功能的储备区分开来。我们进一步提出，临床疾病仅在年龄相关的累积应激超过韧性和储备的联合能力时才会出现。将神经退行性变重新定义为保护系统的失败，为预防和治疗开发提供了新方向。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，提出了一个整合韧性、储备与病理负荷的阈值模型，将ALS等神经退行性疾病的发病机制从单一致病过程转向保护系统失效，具有重要的转化价值。

items.title: Introducing Borsantrazole: A Trifunctional Boron-Based Pyrazole That Extends the Lifespan of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is considered a highly complex, heterogeneous, fatal disease with a high unmet medical need that affects multiple pathophysiological pathways and has no known singular cause. Oxidative stress, however, is implicated as a central player in the progression of ALS and other neurodegenerative diseases. To date, only two FDA-approved drugs, Edaravone, an antioxidant, and Riluzole, an antiglutamatergic, have been widely used clinically, albeit with modest effects on the clinical course of ALS disease progression. Additionally, preclinical studies of both drugs in ALS mouse models have not shown any significant survival benefit, although some abatement in disease progression is observed and translated from preclinical animal models to clinical human studies. Using a trifunctional boron-based drug design strategy, we have synthesized a pyrazole small molecule called Borsantrazole (BSZ) and evaluated BSZ in cell-based experiments, acute and chronic toxicity models, and the SOD1-G37R ALS mouse model. We have also evaluated untargeted global proteomic and phosphoproteomic changes induced by BSZ. Borsantrazole (a small molecule that can selectively target oxidative stress) with favorable CNS drug like properties (low ER values of 0.9 and 1.0 at 1 and 10 µm, respectively, suggesting lower Pgp efflux liability and the LogD at pH 7.4 was within the range of 1.2 to 3.1, suggesting BSZ is lipophilic at pH 7.4.) shows no signs of treatment associated toxicity (acute or chronic (120 days)), significantly increases survival (whole animals, 15.1 days (p = 0.0326); males, 16.5 days; females, 13.7 days), rescued weight loss (27.1% control, 18.3% BSZ, p < 0.0001), delays symptom onset (whole animals, 24.9 days (p = 0.0011); males, 23.3 days; females, 26.4 days), delays disease onset (whole animals, 25.5 days (p = 0.0001); males, 21.1 days; females, 29.8 days) and affects global proteomic changes in the SOD1-G37R mouse model of ALS. In total, 51 proteins were found to be significantly differentially expressed (p < 0.05), including Ca3, Gan, Cplx2, Lrp4, Sqstm1, and 29 phosphorylation sites were differentially expressed and considered statistically significant, including T317 and T72 for neurofilaments light and heavy chain, respectively. Herein, we report that BSZ has demonstrated a favorable safety profile and compelling proof-of-concept efficacy in a ALS mouse model and has the potential to become a disease-modifying ALS therapeutic following further clinical development. Within a broader perspective of treatments for neurodegenerative diseases, BSZ offers a new paradigm for trifunctional small molecule targeting of oxidative stress that can mitigate neuronal deterioration and serve as a potential treatment.
items.titleZh: 介绍Borsantrazole：一种三功能硼基吡唑，可延长肌萎缩侧索硬化症小鼠的寿命。
items.summaryZh: Borsantrazole（BSZ）是一种新合成的三功能硼基吡唑小分子，通过靶向氧化应激发挥作用。在SOD1-G37R ALS小鼠模型中，BSZ显著延长了生存期（整体延长15.1天），延迟了症状和疾病发作，并改善了体重下降。该化合物具有良好的中枢神经系统药物样特性，且未观察到急慢性毒性。蛋白质组学分析显示BSZ影响了51种蛋白质和29个磷酸化位点的表达。
items.insight: BSZ代表了ALS药物开发中一种新颖的化学骨架（硼基吡唑），其通过三功能设计同时靶向氧化应激，并在SOD1小鼠模型中展现出显著的生存获益，这优于目前临床药物在该模型中的表现，值得关注其后续临床转化。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前药物研究（动物模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: Borsantrazole在SOD1-G37R ALS小鼠模型中显著延长生存期15.1天，延迟症状和疾病发作，并改善体重下降，同时具有良好的安全性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）被认为是一种高度复杂、异质性、致命性疾病，具有高度未满足的医疗需求，影响多种病理生理途径，且没有已知的单一病因。然而，氧化应激被认为是ALS和其他神经退行性疾病进展中的核心因素。迄今为止，只有两种FDA批准的药物，抗氧化剂依达拉奉和抗谷氨酸能药物利鲁唑，已在临床上广泛使用，尽管对ALS疾病进展的临床病程影响有限。此外，这两种药物在ALS小鼠模型中的临床前研究并未显示出显著的生存获益，尽管观察到疾病进展有所减缓，并且从临床前动物模型转化到临床人体研究。利用三功能硼基药物设计策略，我们合成了一种名为Borsantrazole（BSZ）的吡唑小分子，并在细胞实验、急性和慢性毒性模型以及SOD1-G37R ALS小鼠模型中评估了BSZ。我们还评估了BSZ诱导的非靶向全局蛋白质组和磷酸化蛋白质组变化。Borsantrazole（一种可选择性地靶向氧化应激的小分子）具有有利的中枢神经系统药物样特性（在1和10 µm时，ER值分别为0.9和1.0，表明Pgp外排风险较低；pH 7.4时的LogD在1.2至3.1范围内，表明BSZ在pH 7.4时具有亲脂性），未显示治疗相关毒性迹象（急性或慢性（120天）），显著延长了生存期（整体动物，15.1天（p = 0.0326）；雄性，16.5天；雌性，13.7天），挽救了体重下降（对照组27.1%，BSZ组18.3%，p < 0.0001），延迟了症状发作（整体动物，24.9天（p = 0.0011）；雄性，23.3天；雌性，26.4天），延迟了疾病发作（整体动物，25.5天（p = 0.0001）；雄性，21.1天；雌性，29.8天），并影响了SOD1-G37R ALS小鼠模型中的全局蛋白质组变化。总共发现51种蛋白质显著差异表达（p < 0.05），包括Ca3、Gan、Cplx2、Lrp4、Sqstm1，以及29个磷酸化位点差异表达并被认为具有统计学意义，包括神经丝轻链的T317和重链的T72。在此，我们报告BSZ在ALS小鼠模型中显示出良好的安全性特征和令人信服的概念验证疗效，并有可能在进一步临床开发后成为一种疾病修饰性ALS治疗药物。从更广泛的神经退行性疾病治疗角度来看，BSZ为靶向氧化应激的三功能小分子提供了一种新范式，可以减轻神经元退化并作为一种潜在的治疗方法。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，报道了一种全新化学骨架（三功能硼基吡唑）在ALS小鼠模型中实现显著生存延长，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Focal epilepsy expands the phenotype of FUS-associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Epileptic seizures are an exceedingly rare manifestation in classic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Emerging case reports suggest a potential link between ALS associated with FUS gene mutations (FUS-ALS) and seizures, expanding the disease's phenotypic spectrum. A 25-year-old man presented with a 5-month history of rapidly progressive limb weakness, atrophy, and both upper and lower motor neuron signs, consistent with ALS. Notably, he developed two types of epileptic seizures during the disease course, including focal motor seizures and focal seizures evolving to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures. Electroencephalography revealed epileptiform discharges over the right frontotemporal region. Brain 18 F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography-computed tomography showed focal hypometabolism in the right frontal cortex. Genetic testing identified a de novo pathogenic FUS variant (c.1574C>T, p.Pro525Leu). The patient was diagnosed with FUS-ALS with comorbid focal epilepsy. Treatment with levetiracetam partially controlled the seizures, but motor function continued to deteriorate. This case highlights focal epilepsy as a comorbid feature in FUS-ALS, broadening the recognized phenotypic spectrum. Genetic testing for FUS mutations should be considered in young-onset ALS patients presenting with seizures.
items.titleZh: 局灶性癫痫扩展了FUS相关肌萎缩侧索硬化症的表型。

items.abstractZh: 癫痫发作在经典肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）中极为罕见。新兴病例报告提示，与FUS基因突变相关的ALS（FUS-ALS）与癫痫发作之间存在潜在联系，扩展了该疾病的表型谱。一名25岁男性出现为期5个月的快速进行性肢体无力、萎缩及上下运动神经元体征，符合ALS诊断。值得注意的是，他在病程中出现了两种类型的癫痫发作，包括局灶性运动性发作和演变为双侧强直-阵挛发作的局灶性发作。脑电图显示右额颞区有癫痫样放电。脑18F-氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描-计算机断层扫描显示右额叶皮质局灶性代谢减低。基因检测发现一个新生致病性FUS变异（c.1574C>T, p.Pro525Leu）。患者被诊断为FUS-ALS合并局灶性癫痫。左乙拉西坦治疗部分控制了癫痫发作，但运动功能持续恶化。本病例强调局灶性癫痫是FUS-ALS的一种共病特征，拓宽了已知的表型谱。对于伴有癫痫发作的年轻发病ALS患者，应考虑进行FUS突变基因检测。
items.frontierRationale: 该病例报告发表于2026年，新近揭示了FUS-ALS与局灶性癫痫的关联，扩展了ALS的表型谱，具有直接的ALS临床转化价值。

items.title: Cardiac autonomic dysfunction is associated with advanced stage, fast progression and poor survival in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: ObjectiveTo investigate the association of cardiac autonomic dysfunction with clinical staging and disease progression rate upon diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and its impact on survival.Methods24-hour Holter was performed in 95 ALS patients at diagnosis and 39 controls. Patients were grouped by King's Clinical Staging and progression rate (ΔFS, median cut-off 0.67). Heart rate variability parameters were compared across groups. A survival-based cut-point optimization approach was used to determine the cut-off value of standard deviation of all normal-to-normal intervals (SDNN). Kaplan-Meier estimator and multivariable Cox regression analysis were used to evaluate of the effect of SDNN on survival during a median follow-up of 21.5 months.ResultsΔFS in ALS patients in King's Stage 4 upon diagnosis was faster ( P =0.007) compared to that of those diagnosed in earlier stages, featuring a higher incidence of respiratory ( P <0.001) and bulbar symptoms ( P <0.001). In addition, ALS patients in King's Stage 4 exhibited elevated HR-min ( P =0.007) and decreased RR intervals (RRI) ( P =0.032), SDNN ( P =0.004), and standard deviation of the averages of NN intervals in all 5-min segments (SDANN) values ( P =0.020) compared to controls. Patients in the ΔFS-fast group had a higher HR-min than those in the ΔFS-slow group ( P =0.013) and controls ( P =0.003) and lower SDNN ( P =0.018) than controls. Both Kaplan-Meier estimator ( P =0.03) and multivariable Cox regression analysis ( P =0.019) showed that lower SDNN (cut-off value: 111 ms) was associated with poor survival in ALS patients.ConclusionUpon diagnosis, ALS patients in King's Stage 4 and with faster disease progression demonstrated significantly diminished cardiac autonomic control. Lower SDNN was associated with poor survival in ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中心脏自主神经功能障碍与晚期、快速进展及不良生存相关
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，ALS患者在诊断时若处于King's 4期或疾病进展较快，其心脏自主神经功能（通过心率变异性指标SDNN等评估）显著下降。较低的SDNN（低于111毫秒）与患者较差的生存率相关。
items.insight: 该研究首次在ALS诊断时系统评估了心脏自主神经功能障碍与临床分期和进展速率的关系，并确定了SDNN作为预后生物标志物的潜在截断值，为ALS的临床风险分层和早期干预提供了新视角。

items.abstractZh: 目的：探讨心脏自主神经功能障碍与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）诊断时临床分期和疾病进展速率的关系，及其对生存的影响。方法：对95名ALS患者在诊断时和39名对照者进行24小时动态心电图监测。根据King's临床分期和进展速率（ΔFS，中位数截断值0.67）对患者进行分组。比较各组的心率变异性参数。采用基于生存的截断值优化方法确定所有正常R-R间期标准差（SDNN）的截断值。在中位随访21.5个月期间，使用Kaplan-Meier估计量和多变量Cox回归分析评估SDNN对生存的影响。结果：King's 4期ALS患者在诊断时的ΔFS快于早期诊断患者（P=0.007），且呼吸系统（P<0.001）和延髓症状（P<0.001）发生率更高。此外，与对照组相比，King's 4期ALS患者表现出最低心率（HR-min）升高（P=0.007），R-R间期（RRI）（P=0.032）、SDNN（P=0.004）和所有5分钟段NN间期平均值的标准差（SDANN）值降低（P=0.020）。ΔFS快组患者的最低心率高于ΔFS慢组（P=0.013）和对照组（P=0.003），SDNN低于对照组（P=0.018）。Kaplan-Meier估计量（P=0.03）和多变量Cox回归分析（P=0.019）均显示，较低的SDNN（截断值：111 ms）与ALS患者的不良生存相关。结论：在诊断时，King's 4期和疾病进展较快的ALS患者表现出显著降低的心脏自主神经控制。较低的SDNN与ALS的不良生存相关。
